action.objective: Verify Qg4, attacking g7 and hitting the loose bishop on g2 while keeping king safety intact.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search ranked Qg4 top (2414 exact) with PV Qg4 Bd5 Qxg7. Black's Bxg2 grabbed a pawn and the bishop sits loose on g2 with no defender visible; Qg4 attacks it and the g7 pawn. Single-candidate verification at depth 4 is needed because the broad score was cutoff and no commit-ready move exists. This uses the reserved verification allowance for d1g4.
